import itertools
sheet = 'Allowed assignments'
rows = data_rows(sheet, {'L': 'string', 'M': 'string', 'N': 'number'}, 812, 820)
data = [(cells(sheet, f'L{r}')[0], cells(sheet, f'M{r}')[0], num(sheet, f'N{r}')) for r in rows]
tasks = list(set(x[0] for x in data))
workers = list(set(x[1] for x in data))
max_covered = 0
for r in range(1, len(tasks) + 1):
    for p in itertools.permutations(workers, r):
        possible = True
        for t, w in zip(tasks[:r], p):
            if not any(x[0] == t and x[1] == w for x in data):
                possible = False
                break
        if possible:
            max_covered = max(max_covered, r)
result = max_covered
